rules: Prefer self-verifying tasks. Judged tasks are at most half of any pack, and the judge is blind, shuffled, and from a different model family than the contestant (SIS arena rules).
Every task states its checker before any run. A task with no checker is not a task.
Sample floor: at least 10 runs per harness-and-task cell before any claim (SIS ROUTING-DOCTRINE A2). Below that the report says 'directional'.
Every pack records caveats: n, judge family, harness overhead, contamination risk.
Pre-register: write the hypothesis, the prediction and the falsifier before collecting data (SIS R5-DESIGN.md is the template).

items.title: Skills and playbooks: do they beat the same agent without them?
items.source: Skill Foundry: claude plugin eval --ablation with-without, run by a judge that did not write the skill
items.weakness: Ablation shows a skill helps on its own evals, not that it helps on real work. Pair it with a core-v0 or web-v0 task per playbook.
